notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38670151/936fe4bd5361a2e5c4a3efb81c6c784ff010f43b.png[/img]

[h2]QOS Update[/h2]
Opponent ghosts will now display the exact actions of opponent races, rather than just their trajectory. This fixes an issue where opponents seem to get an impossible head start at the beginning of each race

[b]New coach quips for the following ships:[/b]
• BMF
• EricForPresident
• TYR

notes.title: SILVER CITY UPDATE 0.3.0
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38670151/a8822f6a788ad9a3478b01d813de46a350271d5a.png[/img]

This place is fast, hopefully you can keep up. The sun shines down on the beautiful architecture by day, but the city is most known for its night life. Good luck catching any of it while you zoom by!


[h2]NEW CONTENT[/h2]

[b]3 NEW SHIPS:[/b]
[*] Matteo311
[*] SoulFox
[*] RhysDaKing

[/list]

- Implemented a new system to prevent exploited race times from being added to the leaderboards
